ops.en: VA-YEDABER — 'and God SPOKE': DABAR, the speak-verb, TOKEN 1 OF 415 IN THE TORAH — the verb of the whole 'and YHWH spoke to Moses' formula is BORN here, on the exit-order, and it is the first divine speech since 7:4: two whole spans of silence end in the verb that will carry the revelation (token 2 = 12:4, spoken to Abram — the verb's first two tokens both restart a world). Speech returns as ELOHI…

ops.x: noach, tevah are READ without prior install (the survivor and the vessel, resumed; the waters are off the page)
ops.en: flag, not fix

THE MACHINE'S TWO SPEECH OPERATORS ARE LEGALLY DIFFERENT [claim G20-12]. The chain rules that every 'God SPOKE' (dibber) introduces a NEW COMMANDMENT, as against the weaker 'said' (amar) - and OUR 8:15 is the stated exhibit: the new law it introduces is the prohibition of a limb taken from a living animal. The distinction the parse layer draws between two speech verbs is a legal one, not a stylist…

The fourth imperative to Noach (TIR-027): TZE — 'GO OUT', answering 7:1's BO ('come'): the door that closed on a command opens on one; the demand-queue takes its FIRST PUSH SINCE GEN_17 (three units of empty traffic end). The roster: you and your WIFE and your sons and your sons' wives — 6:18's covenant-roster (you and your SONS and your wife and your sons' wives) near-verbatim with the WIFE'S POS…

The second demand (TIR-027): BRING OUT every living thing with you — and the command-verb itself carries the span's WRITTEN/READ fork: written HOTZE, read HAYTZE (both hiphil imperative, 'bring out') — the 5th ktiv/qere token in our spans (3:12, 3:20, 4:22, 7:2, here), riding the exit-verb [letter fact, prose-tracked — never machine-resolved; the chain's bring-out-vs-let-out reading is named-only;…

The charge (weqatal, TIR-029, command-bundle fact): AND THEY SHALL SWARM, BE FRUITFUL, AND MULTIPLY — 1:22 and 1:28's blessing verbs re-issued as command-continuation (parah token 3, sharatz token 4): the exit-order quotes the creation blessing back into force [quote-class letter fact; Onkelos re-verbs the swarm as 'breed' — the quote diluted; dual-track].

RELUCTANCE WRITTEN INTO THE VERSE'S DOUBLE FORM [claim G20-13]. At our 8:17 the text is written הוֹצֵא (hotze, 'bring out') and read הַיְצֵא (haitze) - both forms standing in the ink, verified at derivation - and the chain reads the pair as the difference between bringing out and COERCING out: the addressee's reluctance encoded in the written-and-read pair itself. The same verse's 'teem ON THE EAR…

The command's own verb returns as the deed: TZE ('go out!') -> VA-YETZE ('and he went out') — the echo-receipt class (gen_09's make->built, gen_16's make->made, gen_17's come->came). The household files out in 6:18's order — sons before wife: the promise's sequence, not the command's [letter fact, held].

The tze-demand POPPED — SETTLED CYCLE #3: the machine's third command cycle closes in the command's own verb, one verse after the push; the bring-out demand still waits (its receipt belongs to the animals).

BY THEIR FAMILIES THEY WENT OUT: MISHPACHAH ('family') — TOKEN 1 of 185 in the Torah, debuting on ANIMAL clans: the word of the nations table (x5 in Gen 10) and of 12:3's all-the-families-blessed walks out of the ark first on paws and wings [letter fact; Onkelos renders it through the SEED-root — dual-track].

The hotze-demand POPPED — SETTLED CYCLE #4, and the queue is EMPTY again: the commanded BRING-OUT (hiphil) is receipted by their own GOING-OUT (qal, perfect) — the stem shifts from cause-to-go to went [decision recorded]: Noach is never shown herding; the cargo that loaded itself (gen_17) unloads itself, in clans.

THE MANIFEST CHANGED DURING THE VOYAGE [claim G20-14]. Our 8:19 says they emerged 'after their KINDS' - and R. Yochanan reads their kinds, not THEM: some animals that boarded died within the year, and it was their descendants that emerged. The husbandry regime is described in testimony - day-feeders fed by day, night-feeders by night, one creature fed on worms deliberately bred in bran. [folded sh…

VA-YIVEN — 'and Noach BUILT an altar to YHWH': BANAH ('build') token 3 — God builds the rib into woman (2:22), Cain builds a city (4:17), Noach builds THE FIRST ALTAR: the third built thing in the corpus, and the first built for God, unbidden — no command precedes it [letter fact]. MIZBEACH ('altar') — tokens 1-2 of 198, both in this verse (career: Abram's four, the binding's, the Tabernacle's two…

THE FIRST INSTALL SINCE GEN_16: a completed build with a persistent object (the tevah/ir precedent — city, ark, altar: the corpus's three built things, one per builder-class). The WORLD register wakes after four empty units.

The TAKE: of every CLEAN beast and every CLEAN bird — TAHOR tokens 5-6: FROZEN gen_17's prediction ('token 5 = 8:20, THE ALTAR: the clean sevens are sacrifice-stock') LANDS EXACTLY — the cargo arithmetic of 7:2 pays out here, two chapters later, as the frozen unit said it would [frozen-unit prediction landing; letter fact]. LAKACH ('take') token 16 — token 15 was the dove (8:9): the same hand, two…

VA-YAAL OLOT — 'and he OFFERED UP burnt-offerings': OLAH ('burnt-offering', the goes-up offering) — TOKEN 1 of 148; its tokens 2-7 are ALL the binding of Isaac (Gen 22): the offering-class debuts on Noach's altar and reconvenes on Moriah. ALAH ('go up') token 2 — token 1 was 2:6's rising mist: the corpus's second ascent is the first a man sends up.

WHO ACTUALLY OFFERED IS DISPUTED [claim G20-15]. The chain records that the lion maimed him at the exit, leaving him unfit to sacrifice, so that SHEM offered in his place - the altar act reassigned away from this unit's own subject. And our 'of every PURE animal' is the biblical anchor for calling kosher animals pure, cited as such inside the impurity discussions. [folded shape: kept record]

VA-YARACH — 'and YHWH SMELLED the PLEASING odor': three debuts in four words — the smell-verb (token 1 of 5; career: Isaac smelling Jacob's garments 27:27, the incense Exod 30:38, the idols that CANNOT smell Deut 4:28), REIACH ('odor') token 1 of 43, NICHOACH ('pleasing/restful') token 1 of 39 — the sacrificial formula's own word, and a NUACH-family rest-word: the root that landed the ark (8:4 va-…

THE OFFERING-REGARD CLASS, second firing: frozen gen_12 encoded the gaze at Abel's offering as TEST PASS(shaah, hevel_u_minchato) — sense-verb + evaluative noun on an offering; the smell is the same class, so the machine records PASS with the new oracle word [decision on precedent]. The instrument roster: tov (the week), shaah (the gaze), tzaddik (the person), now NICHOACH (the savor).

'And YHWH said TO HIS HEART' — divine INTERIOR speech: the counter-resolve to gen_15's wipe-resolve, spoken where no creature hears. LEV ('heart') tokens 3-4 are both in this verse; tokens 1-2 were 6:5 (man's evil heart) and 6:6 (God's grieved heart): the heart-word's first four tokens frame the flood — grief spoke the decree into the same organ that now speaks the pardon [letter fact; Onkelos mov…

NEVER-AGAIN #1, installed as a STANDING CONSTRAINT [decision: a perpetual negation with no possible execution receipt is not a demand — nothing can ever pop never-again; the INVARIANT class carries it]. The bookends, each DB-verified: QALAL ('be light / curse') token 3 — gen_19's arc lands (the waters LIGHTENED at 8:8/8:11; the ground never again LIGHTENED-against); BAAVUR ('for the sake of') toke…

NEVER-AGAIN #2, alone on the verse-end arm: 'never again to STRIKE all living AS I HAVE DONE' — NAKAH ('strike') token 2 (token 1 = 4:15, the clause protecting Cain from being struck: both early tokens are strike-limits); YASAF ('add/again') tokens 5-6 are this double LO OSIF, right after the dove's tokens 3-4 (8:10, 8:12): the again-verb migrates from the bird's errand to the everlasting pledge; …

SMELL REVERSES THE DECREE, AND IS THEN RANKED [claim G20-16]. The sequence - He smelled the pleasing aroma, then said He would not curse again - is read as appeasement achieved through smell, held as potent as eating. The offering is then compared with Israel's later offerings and proven the LESSER, because of Israel's it is said 'MY pleasing aroma YOU SHALL KEEP' - a command to repeat, which this…

A REPETITION READ AS AN OATH, AND A DESCRIPTION READ AS A STATUTE [claim G20-17]. 'I will not continue... I will not continue' is read as carrying OATH force rather than emphasis. And 'the inclination of man's heart is evil FROM HIS YOUTH' is the stated basis of a concrete purity ruling about a toddler, with a defective-spelling parse reading the word as 'from his AWAKENING' - that is, from birth.…

The eight-beat merism installed as ONE standing constraint with the letter's own duration clause (OD KOL-YEMEI HA-ARETZ, 'all the days of the earth' — OD token 8, closing the particle's six-token run across this chapter). The pledge is built of ONCE-WORDS: QOR ('cold'), QAYITZ ('summer'), CHOREF ('winter') — three Torah hapaxes; CHOM ('heat') has 2 tokens (the other: 18:1, the heat of Abraham's da…

THE GUARANTEE IS CONDITIONAL, AND IT CHANGES THE WORLD RATHER THAN RESTORING IT [claim G20-18]. The seasons-covenant is read as enduring only WHILE THE EARTH ENDURES, so its annulment is discussable, and two versions of that are recorded. And R. Acha reads the clause as INSTALLING conditions that did not exist before: because the flood generation sowed once in forty years and never buried children…
